summary: Coaching CRM - clients, programs, check-ins, and scheduling, drivable by the agent.
systemOfRecord: Every client and everything about them - programs, workouts, nutrition plans, weekly check-ins and their measurements, progress reports, forms, appointments and tasks - lives in Protocol; read and write it with the protocol tools, never from workspace files.

apiKey.hint: Agent key (pk_…) from the AI Agent page

provision.grants: Full coach-level access to your whole Protocol account over its REST API - broader than the MCP connection above. Only needed for the few things MCP deliberately cannot do: billing, permanent deletes, and messaging clients. Requires you to be the account owner, and replaces any previous key issued to this machine.
